## Actions

| Action | Label | Effect | Shortcut | Policy | Invalidates |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `load-wallet` | Load wallet | read | - | viewer.can(viewer.read) | - |
| `pick-contact` | Pick contact | reversible | `shift+c` | wallet.can(wallet.manage) | wallet |
| `pick-token` | Pick token | reversible | `shift+t` | wallet.can(wallet.manage) | wallet |
| `send` | Send | irreversible | `mod+enter` | wallet.requires(unlocked, account, wallet.send) | wallet |
| `toggle-hide-dust` | Toggle hide dust | reversible | `shift+d` | wallet.can(wallet.manage) | wallet |

Invoke an action by its control (`data-rex="<page>/<action>"`), its shortcut, the URL `<route>?act=<action>&input=<json>` or the command palette (mod+k). Irreversible actions ask for confirmation on every route.

## Folder convention

- app/pages/<page>/page.ts: the page declaration (route, params, policy, actions, chrome, regions, overlays, states); imports entities, actions and policies, never React.
- app/pages/<page>/view.tsx: layout of regions only; imports regions and layout primitives, never hooks, data or parts.
- app/pages/<page>/states.tsx: one export per declared non-ready state; imports parts and DesignX, never hooks.
- app/pages/<page>/hooks/use<Name>.ts: page-private state and queries; imports app/data and actions, never components.
- app/pages/<page>/regions/<region>/region.tsx: binds hooks to parts; the only hook caller; never imports other regions or pages.
- app/pages/<page>/regions/<region>/parts/<Part>.tsx: pure components, props in, events out; import DesignX components and types only.
- app/pages/<page>/overlays/<Overlay>.tsx: sheets, dialogs and drawers with declared dismissal; import parts and DesignX, never data fetching.
- app/pages/<page>/test/: page tests.
- app/actions, app/entities, app/policies, app/flows: one declaration per file; app/components: DesignX copies; app/data: stores and queries.

Every page renders `data-rex-page`, every region `data-rex-region`, every overlay `data-rex-overlay`, and one `application/rex+json` sidecar script with id `rex-page`.
